concepts.gloss_en: The Land of Israel itself (bound up with faith, prayer, miracles)
The holiness of the Land of Israel — an attribute/quality of the Land, not the Land itself

members.note: construct head is קדשה (holiness of X); a state about the Land, not the Land — rule 4

concepts.gloss_en: Inheriting/inheritance of the Land of Israel — an action/event of acquiring the Land, not the Land itself

members.note: construct head is ירשה (inheritance of X); tied here to the mitzvah of challah as immediate acquisition — action about the Land, not the Land — rule 4

notes: Three distinct concepts sharing the token ארץ ישראל but with different construct heads (the Land; its holiness; its inheritance). Per rule 4, an attribute/action about X is not X — kept separate.
